clips.title: The story
paras: On Thunder Bluff, Incendia Powder is prepared to call a sacred spirit into the open. Magatha Grimtotem enchants it for use at Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

Incendia Powder carries shamanic magic to the sacred fire atop Darkcloud Pinnacle. Magatha Grimtotem entrusts it to travelers on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Scattered across the consecrated brazier where the dead are laid to rest, the powder calls forth Arikara, a vengeful winged serpent.
